_comment: AI-difficulty tiers for the enemy DECISION strategy (Scripts/AI/enemy_ai_strategy.gd, loaded by Scripts/Data/ai_strategy_data.gd). Independent axis from curse difficulty (GameParameters/curses.json) - see plans/AI_DIFFICULTY_PLAN.md. Strictly additive: impossible = every flag on, each lower tier is a subset. All four keys-per-tier are required for all four tiers (no implicit defaults across tiers).
_comment_danger_avoid_prob: Probability the chase step (heuristic path) prefers a candidate not reachable by any ally next turn. Was GameParameters/ai_config.json's per-CURSE-difficulty danger_avoid_prob (easy/normal/hard) - now per-AI-difficulty (normal/hard/extreme/impossible), see base_character.calculate_best_move + enemy_ai_strategy.gd.
_comment_avoid_hanging_pieces: Generalizes danger_avoid_prob from the chase step to EVERY candidate (captures included) - value-aware, never leaves zero moves.
_comment_static_exchange_evaluation: SEE - before committing to a capture, checks whether the destination square is itself defended and whether the recapture would lose more material than the capture gained.
_comment_threat_creation: Fork bonus - small evaluation bump for candidates that threaten 2+ player pieces simultaneously next turn.
_comment_min_max: Switches the strategy from the heuristic ladder (value-aware capture then chase) to minimax search over all valid_targets (captures included).
_comment_minimax_depth: Adversarial-reply plies for minimax (0 = min_max off). See enemy_ai_strategy.gd _minimax() - radius-bounded opponent move generation, alpha-beta required.
_comment_curse_synergy: Enables BaseCurse.ai_positioning_bonus() scoring inside the minimax evaluation function - only meaningful when min_max is also true.
